title: H3 text encoder: swap the 26.4GB int8_convrot for the 15.7GB NVFP4 AWQ build
description: Fabio compared Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors (15,687,142,551 bytes) against the shipped ethanfel Ultra-Heretic int8_convrot (26,363,476,151) on uncensored and hard prompts: identical results, so the Comfy-Org build is already uncensored and the Heretic lineage is not needed. Swap it. Takes the H3 staging pair from ~45GB to ~35GB, which is the real fix for the L4 OOM (minimax-h3/t2v_ms SIGKILL, code -9). Upload to R2, rewrite the dep entry, keep the old entry for the orphan sweep, then re-run the L4 smoke.
